entry.idea: ProjectX gives people a cloud computer that keeps their desktop apps, files, and AI agents running all the time, so they are not limited by the power of their own device.
entry.lesson: A founder's own early struggle with weak hardware can point straight at a real product gap once new technology, like AI agents, makes that gap urgent for many more people.
entry.name: ProjectX

growth.reason: No user, revenue, or funding numbers are available, and most other search results under this name belong to unrelated organizations, leaving nothing solid to measure growth by.

market.reason: A cloud workspace for desktop apps and AI agents could be used by almost anyone who needs more computing power than their own device offers, which is a large worldwide market.

tech.reason: It looks like a cloud virtual desktop built for AI agents, an area where other cloud and virtual-desktop providers already compete, so it is unclear how hard it would be to copy.

sources.title: Rural village upbringing inspired cloud computing startup
ProjectX: Agent native workspace for heavy parallel workflows on the web | Y Combinator

entry.twist: The founder grew up without access to good computers in a rural village, and says that shaped the idea of moving all the heavy computing work to the cloud.
entry.who_pays: People and teams who want a powerful, always-on desktop and AI agents in the cloud would pay to use the workspace.
entry.why_now: AI agents increasingly need to run many tasks at once around the clock, which ordinary personal computers are not built for, making an always-on cloud workspace more useful now.

mentions.snippet: Keeps desktop apps, files and AI agents in one persistent cloud workspace, removing local hardware limits.
